_comment: Domain registry for FLEET_SELFREPAIR_DESIGN.md §3/§4.1. A domain names a path scope (prefixes/globs within hermes-self-repair-read.py's own allowlist.json, never outside it -- see that file's header for why the allowlist lives in the tool's own installation, not the target checkout), a detection source, a completeness rule, a cadence, and its own self-managed-mode switch, independent of every other domain. Read by tools/hermes_self_repair_domains.py (underscore-named -- importable, unlike every hyphenated *.py in tools/); nothing else parses this file directly. Domain #1 (minecraft-bots) was added here in Phase 3 (§8.3), after the completeness hook (§4.3, tools/hermes_self_repair_completeness.py) and detection bridge (§4.4, tools/hermes-self-repair-minecraft-bridge.py) it depends on were both built and offline-tested. self_managed starts false (§3's own table: 'Off by default, scoped to this domain only') -- flipping it to true is what actually lets the detection bridge auto-submit real tasks from live triage incidents, a separate, deliberate decision from registering the domain itself.
